propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryCornerFixingPlate
propertySets.definition: Properties specific to corner fixing plates.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateLength
properties.definition: The length of the L-shaped corner plate.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the L-shaped corner plate.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneZ
properties.definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane Z.

properties.name: CornerFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneX
properties.definition: The flange width of the L-shaped corner plate in plane X.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryDiagonalTrussConnector
propertySets.definition: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with diagonal cross-bars.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussHeight
properties.definition: The overall height of the truss connector.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussLength
properties.definition: The overall length of the truss connector.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussCrossBarSpacing
properties.definition: The spacing between diagonal cross-bar sections.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussBaseBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussSecondaryBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

properties.name: DiagonalTrussCrossBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the diagonal cross-bars.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryEdgeFixingPlate
propertySets.definition: Properties specific to edge fixing plates.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateLength
properties.definition: The length of the L-shaped edge plate.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the L-shaped edge plate.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneZ
properties.definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane Z.

properties.name: EdgeFixingPlateFlangeWidthInPlaneX
properties.definition: The flange width of the L-shaped edge plate in plane X.

properties.name: FixingSocketTypeReference
properties.definition: Type reference for the fixing socket according to local standards.

properties.name: FixingSocketHeight
properties.definition: The overall height of the fixing socket.

properties.name: FixingSocketThreadDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the thread.

properties.name: FixingSocketThreadLength
properties.definition: The length of the threaded part of the fixing socket.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryLadderTrussConnector
propertySets.definition: Shape properties specific to connecting accessories in truss form with straight cross-bars in ladder shape.

properties.name: LadderTrussHeight
properties.definition: The overall height of the truss connector.

properties.name: LadderTrussLength
properties.definition: The overall length of the truss connector.

properties.name: LadderTrussCrossBarSpacing
properties.definition: The spacing between the straight cross-bars.

properties.name: LadderTrussBaseBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the base bar.

properties.name: LadderTrussSecondaryBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the secondary bar.

properties.name: LadderTrussCrossBarDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the straight cross-bars.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryStandardFixingPlate
propertySets.definition: Properties specific to standard fixing plates.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateWidth
properties.definition: The width of the standard fixing plate.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateDepth
properties.definition: The depth of the standard fixing plate.

properties.name: StandardFixingPlateThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the standard fixing plate.

propertySets.name: Pset_DiscreteAccessoryWireLoop
propertySets.definition: Shape properties common to wire loop joint connectors.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateThickness
properties.definition: The thickness of the base plate.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateWidth
properties.definition: The width of the base plate.

properties.name: WireLoopBasePlateLength
properties.definition: The length of the base plate.

properties.name: WireDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the wire.

properties.name: WireEmbeddingLength
properties.definition: The length of the part of wire which is embedded in the precast concrete element.

properties.name: WireLoopLength
properties.definition: The length of the fastening loop part of the wire.
